rulebook_motion.document: RoboMaster 2026 University Championship Rule Manual V2.1.0 (20260717)

evidence: Rulebook V2.1.0 section 5.6.5: target and guiding light maintain their relative positions and translate parallel to field width from -280mm to +280mm.
The physical fixed rail is longer than this allowed carriage travel. A four-second sine sweep is demo-only when no target mode is selected; it is not a match controller or a rulebook cruising speed.

geometry_additions.name: base/reconstructed/inner_housing
evidence: Rulebook V2.1.0 Figure 4-12: lower armor sits above the plinth; open upper bays surround a narrow red central column. Replaces the previous full-height triangular solid.
Low triangular mounting plinth is an approximate support, not recovered manufacturer internals.

Donor LED material group 2 contains the paired red light bars. Source geometry and remaining materials are retained.

evidence: Rulebook V2.1.0 section 5.6.5, printed pages 124-125: the target translates with its guiding light within +/-280mm.
Explicit triangle ranges select the complete disconnected central target components above z=0.965m in the pinned source assembly, plus its red/gray surface groups. The lower rail mounts remain fixed.

evidence: Green guiding-light source surface; Figure 4-13 identifies this light as part of the Base Dart Detection Module. Section 5.6.5 requires it to maintain its position relative to the moving detector.
